scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply attendance --local
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy
scripts.format: prettier --write src shared worker scripts tests e2e *.ts *.jsonc *.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src shared worker scripts tests e2e *.ts *.jsonc *.json
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:real-preview: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --env real-preview
